prompt.en: To see anything down here, put that many on Sadaf's shell.
prompt.ar: لِتَرَى شَيْئًا هُنَا فِي الأَسْفَل، ضَعْ هَذَا العَدَدَ عَلَى صَدَفَةِ صَدَف.

hint1.en: Count them as you put each one on.

hint2.en: Take one back off if you went too far.

model.en: Watch. That is what that many looks like. Now you make one.
model.ar: شَاهِد. هَكَذَا يَبْدُو هَذَا العَدَد. اِصْنَعْ أَنْتَ وَاحِدًا الآن.

success.en: Sadaf is glowing. She is the only light down there now.
success.ar: صَدَفُ تَتَوَهَّج. صَارَتْ هِيَ الضَّوْءَ الوَحِيدَ فِي الأَسْفَل.

payload._comment: giveN, not countAndPick, and that is why this activity exists rather than being a second counting scene. 'How many are there?' can be answered by reciting over the objects; 'bring me four' cannot. A child who counts to ten out loud and still hands over a fistful has not got cardinality yet, and this is the only task in the chapter that would notice.
payload._stageComment: The thing being filled is SADAF, not a bowl. She brightens one step per round and stays bright, so what the child made is carried by a character into the next activity instead of being scored and forgotten — and the light they made is literally what lets them see the wall they draw on next.
payload._supplyComment: The drift always holds more than the answer. A supply of exactly the right size answers the question for the child — take everything, hand it over — which is the classic way a give-N task is defeated by accident.

prompt.en: The trench wall is four fathoms high. Put four strands on her shell.
prompt.ar: جِدَارُ الأُخْدُودِ أَرْبَعُ قَامَات. ضَعْ أَرْبَعَةَ خُيُوطٍ عَلَى صَدَفَتِهَا.

revealLine.en: Four strands. The light reaches the wall.

prompt.en: Now three shells, to drop behind us and mark the way home.
prompt.ar: وَالآنَ ثَلَاثُ صَدَفَات، نُلْقِيهَا خَلْفَنَا لِتَدُلَّنَا عَلَى طَرِيقِ العَوْدَة.

revealLine.en: Three shells. Now we can always find our way back up.
revealLine.ar: ثَلَاثُ صَدَفَات. صِرْنَا نَعْرِفُ دَائِمًا طَرِيقَ الصُّعُود.

prompt.en: Under the ledge it gets darker. Two more strands.
prompt.ar: تَحْتَ الحَافَةِ يَزْدَادُ الظَّلَام. خَيْطَانِ آخَرَان.

revealLine.en: Two more. Sadaf is bright enough for the whole wall.
revealLine.ar: خَيْطَانِ آخَرَان. صَارَتْ صَدَفُ مُضِيئَةً بِمَا يَكْفِي لِلجِدَارِ كُلِّه.
